email_subject: Application - Customer Success Manager at Great Place To Work®
email_body:
Dear Kirby,

I'm applying for the Customer Success Manager role at Great Place To Work®. Your mission to help organisations build high-trust cultures resonates with me, and I'd love to bring my client-facing digital experience to your team.

In my current roles, I manage client websites and SEO projects end-to-end: onboarding, advising on platform adoption, and translating needs into customised solutions. I'm comfortable working virtually, coordinating multiple projects, and using data to guide decisions. My background in WordPress, analytics, and survey-style reporting means I can quickly grasp Emprising and help clients act on their results. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I'm eager to strengthen my Dutch in a professional context.

I'm organised, meticulous, and commercially minded, and I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Kirby,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Success Manager position at Great Place To Work®. Your purpose of helping organisations create high-trust, high-performance workplaces aligns closely with my own experience in client-facing digital roles, where I've seen how the right tools and guidance can transform how teams work together.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage a diverse portfolio of client projects, primarily through online interactions. I handle onboarding, provide ongoing support, and advise clients on how to get the most from their websites and digital platforms. For example, I built and optimised a multi-page site for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running iterative audits that measurably improved search health. I also work with WordPress and Elementor to build and maintain sites, including a pharmacists' association with around 600 member profile pages, which requires careful organisation and attention to detail.

I'm data-savvy and comfortable using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to derive actionable insights. I regularly translate client needs into customised proposals, whether that's a new content strategy or a technical SEO fix. My commercial mindset comes from managing my own freelance projects and identifying opportunities to add value, such as upselling additional services or cross-selling complementary solutions.

I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level and A2+ speaking. While I'm not yet fluent in Dutch, I'm committed to improving quickly, and I'm confident my strong organisational skills and client-centric approach will allow me to succeed in a virtual setting. I'm eager to learn Emprising and to help clients understand and act on their survey results.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
